Ledger with full state, 35 rulings and ordered resume instructions: .superpowers/sdd/2026-09-11-configurable-priorities-stage-1/progress.md in that worktree, backed up with every brief and report to docs/superpowers/plans/stage-1-workspace-backup/ in the main checkout.

Remaining: fix one renderer gap in task 9, review task 9, then docs (task 10), then the format-generation bump (task 11, must be the last commit), then a whole-branch review that runs the full gitstore and cli suites — neither has been run by any task, by design.
